description: Keeps Bluetooth speakers and headphones awake by continuously playing a near-silent sound. Press NVDA+Shift+B to toggle, NVDA+Shift+Alt+B to change the sound (quiet low tone, quiet high tone or true silence) and NVDA+Control+Shift+B to change the tone volume.
changelog: Store release: GPL v2 licensing and store-ready metadata. No functional changes from 1.0.2.
